notes.title: Update June 21st, 2021
notes.content:
An update was just submitted that fixes various bugs with the initial pre-release.
Expect a new round of updates later in the week.

notes.title: Update for June 21, 2021
notes.content:
1) Look Circle Shader issue is fixed and no longer has layering issues with trees.

2) Waypoint shader issue is also fixed and no longer has layering issues with water.

3) Added more SFX particles to explosions
